signals.title: Codex iOS turns queued prompts into a host-synchronized, background-capable operator queue
signals.title_zh: Codex iOS 将 Queued Prompts 变成跨 Host 同步、可后台发送的操作队列
signals.summary: OpenAI's September 1 Codex iOS update says queued prompts synchronize with the connected host, remain editable, and can send while the app is in the background; Priority view also surfaces running tasks and tasks awaiting a response.
signals.summary_zh: OpenAI 9 月 1 日的 Codex iOS 更新说明：Queued Prompt 会与 Connected Host 同步、保持可编辑，并可在 App 后台时发送；Priority View 还会优先显示 Running Task 与 Awaiting Response Task。

researchValue.failure: A mobile control surface can become a transient chat UI that loses operator intent or cannot safely hand work to the actual execution host.
researchValue.mechanism: Persist operator prompts as a host-synchronized queue whose state survives mobile backgrounding and remains editable until dispatch.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee mobile control should model command admission, queue state, host binding, and response-required states independently from the phone UI.

signals.title: GitHub binds Copilot model access to the organization that pays for the request
signals.title_zh: GitHub 将 Copilot Model Access 绑定到实际承担用量费用的组织
signals.summary: For users holding Copilot seats in multiple organizations, GitHub now determines model access only from the organization paying for usage rather than allowing any organization with an enabled model to grant access.
signals.summary_zh: 对于同时持有多个组织 Copilot Seat 的用户，GitHub 现在只依据承担该次 Usage Billing 的组织决定 Model Access，不再由任一已启用该模型的组织放行。

researchValue.failure: A user can inherit conflicting model permissions from multiple organizations when policy authority is not bound to the principal that owns the request's cost and governance context.
researchValue.mechanism: Resolve model admission from the billing/governance principal for the current usage context instead of unioning permissions across memberships.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise agent runtimes should bind model/tool policy to the current owning organization or cost center at call time.

signals.title: Codex fails closed when Guardian cannot prove a compaction checkpoint is compatible
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Guardian 无法证明 Compaction Checkpoint 兼容时 Fail Closed
signals.summary: Codex records the producing model's compatibility hash on compaction checkpoints and requires synchronous Guardian review when the latest checkpoint has unknown or incompatible provenance, preventing cached or asynchronous approval from omitting compacted context.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 在 Compaction Checkpoint 上记录 Producing Model Compatibility Hash；当最新 Checkpoint 的 Provenance 未知或不兼容时，强制同步 Guardian Review，避免 Cached/Async Approval 漏掉被压缩的上下文。

researchValue.failure: Authorization evidence can survive as a score while the context it was based on has been compacted by an incompatible producer, creating a stale approval.
researchValue.mechanism: Bind compacted authorization context to producer compatibility provenance and force fresh synchronous review when provenance cannot be proven compatible.
researchValue.implication: Long-running agents should treat context compaction as an authorization-boundary transition, not a transparent storage optimization.

signals.title: Codex preserves MCP authentication challenges but does not automatically replay the rejected tool call
signals.title_zh: Codex 保留 MCP Authentication Challenge，但不自动重放被拒绝的 Tool Call
signals.summary: Codex carries WWW-Authenticate challenges through MCP tool errors when silent OAuth refresh fails, including multiple challenges, while explicitly avoiding automatic replay of the rejected tool call.
signals.summary_zh: 当 Silent OAuth Refresh 失败时，Codex 会把 WWW-Authenticate Challenge（包括多个 Challenge）保留到 MCP Tool Error 中，同时明确不自动重放被拒绝的 Tool Call。

researchValue.failure: An authentication recovery path can erase the challenge needed for user recovery or replay a side-effecting tool call after credentials change.
researchValue.mechanism: Preserve the server's authentication challenge as durable recovery evidence, but require an explicit subsequent call rather than automatically replaying the failed action.
researchValue.implication: Auth recovery and side-effect retry should be separate state transitions with independent authorization and idempotency controls.

sourceIdentityCorrection.reason: Authoritative GitHub commit verification found that the declared SHA did not exist and confirmed the matching maintainer change under the corrected full SHA.

signals.title: Google ADK makes a human-confirmation pause non-summarizable to prevent tool reinvocation loops
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 Human Confirmation Pause 设为不可 Summarize，防止 Tool Reinvocation Loop
signals.summary: ADK marks paused MCP tool calls awaiting confirmation with skip_summarization so the model does not summarize the paused call and invoke it again, eliminating a confirmation loop.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 对等待确认而暂停的 MCP Tool Call 设置 skip_summarization，避免模型把暂停状态摘要后再次调用同一工具，从而消除 Confirmation Loop。

researchValue.failure: A pause awaiting human approval can be interpreted by the model as unfinished conversational work and cause the same side-effecting tool to be invoked again.
researchValue.mechanism: Make approval-pending tool calls terminal to model summarization for the current turn while keeping them resumable by the control plane.
researchValue.implication: HITL pause must be an explicit runtime state that suppresses autonomous replanning until the authorization event arrives.

signals.title: A reproducible artifact compares security benchmarks for agentic LLM systems rather than relying on benchmark claims alone
signals.title_zh: 一份可复现实验 Artifact 对比 Agentic LLM Security Benchmarks，而不是只接受 Benchmark 声明
signals.summary: The Zenodo reproduction artifact packages assessment results, scripts, and instructions for comparing several agentic-LLM security frameworks and benchmarks in a reproducible evaluation setting.
signals.summary_zh: 该 Zenodo Reproduction Artifact 提供多个 Agentic LLM Security Framework/Benchmark 的评估结果、脚本与复现实验说明，用于可重复的跨 Benchmark 比较。

researchValue.failure: Security benchmark names can be treated as interchangeable evidence even when their threat models, tasks, and reproducibility differ materially.
researchValue.finding: The artifact makes cross-benchmark assessment reproducible by packaging evaluation outputs with scripts and execution instructions.
researchValue.mechanism: Compare benchmark applicability through a shared reproducible assessment workflow rather than importing benchmark scores as equivalent evidence.
researchValue.implication: Agent-governance evaluation should record benchmark threat model, reproducibility evidence, and applicability boundaries before using a score for product claims.
